content: Ẹnyọhng ch'egor-ogori ka Babẹl
Iwa anọng m'ọyagbin biphyir akhaam ebhon dani, bẹ am-abira agbaak odik wani.
Mada anọng areng achina k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-eyin, bẹ akwu are ẹttẹri dani k'okhubha kwa Shina
, bẹ atzima mẹ asi oruk kwabẹ.

Mẹ wọ ofon, bẹ an-aben ayok bi, “Bọng kwu ifha mọbanga idọdọhbh k'apyi, mọyaan sẹ maa, sẹ igwu igaangi bi kpọkhọdọ.” Mẹ wọ ofon, bẹ abanga adọdọhbh-pyi atzima atzera atza p'ihọhm, bẹ atzima ana p'abang-ọbanga abira pyi bi kaang, atzima atzera idọdọhbh idukhasẹ.
Mẹ wọ osi, bẹ aben bi, “Bọng kwu mosi odedenmon ttara ẹnyọhng ch'egori bi kotoong maa, epyiri k'ọrọngkpakpa, ifha mosi che ọnang for sa man. Oni mando ode, mọraam-ọraami m'ọyagbin.”
Mẹ wọ ofon, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọhakha okwu ore obhon nwa, ọmaana ẹnyọhng gorang-gor cha va p'anọngẹya am-asi.

Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, oben bi, “Ojemi da bẹ atzima ade anọng p'ẹkhọma dani, p'agbaakhi ebhon dani, bẹ attẹwọr afha asi ọttọhk-dema mva, kw'oyini bi, ọttọhk fa bẹ ákham bi bẹ asi, fa bẹ án-afha asi kóde.
Bọng kwu mọhakha, mọtza ọdama ebhon chabẹ, ifha bẹ aningi ayok dọk abhaang.”
Mẹ wọ osi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi osi anọng mba araami k'ibe kpenamkpen m'ọyagbin, obiro ọkwọbha bẹ odedenmon nwuma osisi.
Kwẹ kwọ osi bẹ ayeri ibe nnuma Babẹl
, okhuri bi, m'ibe nna rọ s'iwa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọdam ebhon ch'ọyagbin biphyir. Ttẹwọr mẹ wọ kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi opfuri bẹ, bẹ araami makhọra ọyagbin.
Ẹnọmma cha Shẹm
Ma wọ ode ẹnọmma cha Shẹm. Wa cho afa akk'akwọbha kw'asi achi ọyagbin, k'ogbe kwa Shẹm on-ode cho arọbh azen, mẹ kw'obhoni Arphaksad.
Mada okk'Arphaksad obhona, wa Shẹm obiro oruk cho ẹnọhna obhiri arọbh azen, obiro obhon ajinọng ọmaana panọng adọdọk.
Mada Arphaksad okk'cho ẹrọbh obhiri chi orukha, obhon Shẹla.
Mada okk'Shẹla obhona, wa Arphaksad obiro oruk cho ẹnọhna obhiri attaan, obiro obhon ajinọng ọmaana panọng adọdọk.
Mada Shẹla okk'cho ẹrọbh obhiri jobh orukha, wa obhon Ẹbẹr.
Mada okk'Ẹbẹr obhona, wa Shẹla obiro oruk cho ẹnọhna obhiri attaan, obiro obhon ajinọng ọmaana panọng adọdọk.
Mada Ẹbẹr okk'cho ẹrọbh obhiri ọhawani-kwa-chi orukha, obhon Pẹlẹg.
Mada okk'Pẹlẹg obhona, wa Ẹbẹr obiro oruk cho ẹnọhna obhiri ẹrọbh obhiri jobh, obiro obhon ajinọng ọmaana panọng adọdọk.
Mada Pẹlẹg okk'cho ẹrọbh obhiri jobh orukha, obhon Rewu.
Mada okk'Rewu obhona, wa Pẹlẹg obiro oruk cho arọbh jobh obhiri ọhawani, obiro obhon ajinọng ọmaana panọng adọdọk.
Mada Rewu okk'cho ẹrọbh obhiri jobh obhiri afa orukha, obhon Serug.
Mada okk'Serug obhona, wa Rewu obiro oruk cho arọbh jobh obhiri azenamfa, obiro obhon ajinọng ọmaana panọng adọdọk.
Mada Serug okk'cho ẹrọbh obhiri jobh orukha, obhon Nahọr.
Mada okk'Nahọr obhona, wa Serug obiro oruk cho arọbh jobh, obiro obhon ajinọng ọmaana panọng adọdọk.
Mada Nahọr okk'cho ẹrọbh obhiri ọhawani orukha, obhon Tẹra.
Mada okk'Tẹra obhona, wa Nahọr obiro oruk cho arọbh azen obhiri ọhawani-kw'ẹrọbh, obiro obhon ajinọng ọmaana panọng adọdọk.
Mada Tẹra okk'cho arọbh attaan obhiri jobh orukha, obhon Abram, ọmaana Nahọr ttara Haran.
Ẹnọmma cha Tẹra
Ma wọ ode ẹnọmma cha Tẹra. Tẹra obhoni Abram, ọmaana Nahọr ttara Haran. Haran obiro obhon Lọt.
Wa Haran ocheden ope, oji otte. M'ogbe nwuma, wa bẹ awobh ka Ur k'okhubha kw'abaKaldi kw'ode obhon kw'iwa Haran ọmaan.
Wa Abram ọmaana Nahọr an-abira atzọkha panọng. Kwanọng kw'Abram wa okpen Sarai. Yina, wa Nahọr ọtzọkha kwanọng kw'okpen Milka. Milka ọkhaam ọgbaanọkka kw'okpen Iska, Haran wọ iwa obhoni bẹ anọng afa.
Yina, Sarai wa ode ojididima, wa kẹ nnwa kọmaani.

Wa Tẹra ọtzọkha Abram kw'ode nnwa kwẹ, ọmaana Lọt kw'ode nnwa kwa Haran, ttara Sarai, kw'ode kwanọng kwa nnwa kwẹ Abram, bẹ biphyir abina orenga achina kw'okhubha kw'Ur kw'abaKaldi, ifha bẹ achina k'ẹkhọma cha Kenaan. Yina, mada bẹ areng maa aphyiri ka Haran, bẹ an-aruk mẹ.
Wa Tẹra okwu ope ma Haran da ode cho arọbh jobh obhiri azen.

footnotes.text: 11.9 Babẹl obiro okpena, Babilọn; k'eHiburu Babẹl okheri ọwọhng kw'oyini, adama.
